title: Copper string
description: This mod adds a copper thread, it can replace the usual one in some tools, and has its own crafting!
body: This mod adds a copper thread. You can craft it from a piece of iron and a copper ingot. If you need threads and you have these materials, you can craft a copper thread. You can use it to create a bow or a fishing rod using sticks. The copper thread fits into a stack of 64 items, and has a separate texture.
